source.name: Herbalife – 'Herbalife and LA Galaxy Unveil 2024 Jersey Ahead of Opening Season Match Against Inter Miami CF at Dignity Health Sports Park'
source.quote: our valued partner, Herbalife, will be featured in the front of our jersey for the 17th consecutive season

note: Front-of-jersey partner since at least the 2008 season (17th consecutive season as of 2024) and still front partner for 2026 (For Soccer, February 2026). No reported deal value.
